about: The startup dashboard: one page, rebuilt from the repo and GitHub on every merge to main and every three hours by the dashboard workflow. Only the founder edits this file (the deploy gate). host: where it is served, for example pm.example.com; empty means it is built but never deployed. provider: who serves it, "cloudflare" (the default) or "vercel". cloudflare_pages_project: the Cloudflare Pages project that serves it; the workflow deploys only when a Cloudflare Access application with a login policy covers both the host and <project>.pages.dev. vercel_project and vercel_team (a team slug or team_ id; empty for a personal account): the Vercel project that serves it, which must serve nothing else (no Git repository connected); the workflow deploys only when that project has the host as a domain and Vercel Authentication on All Deployments. Either way it checks after each deploy that an anonymous visitor gets the login page, not the dashboard. Setup: the handbook, 'The startup dashboard'. documents: the business documents to show; product and technical documents (specs/, docs/) are always added and grouped. portfolio_url: optional; when this venture is on a portfolio, its address (https://...), shown as a link back at the top of the dashboard; portfolio_name: the portfolio's name for that link (default 'Portfolio'). notify: the needs-you workflow keeps an issue labelled needs-you listing everything waiting on you and mentions you for each new item and in a daily digest at digest_hour_utc, so GitHub emails you (enabled false turns it off).
